verdict.rationale: Typesense's ranking and relevance guide has sections on "Promoting or Hiding Results (Merchandising)" and "Boosting / Burying sets of records", and there is a dedicated curation API page, so pinning, boosting and hiding hits are first-party capabilities. The evidence pack never mentions synonyms, and the curation coverage is only section headings with no detail on per-query rules. missing for 10: any evidence of synonym definition, documented detail of per-query pin/hide rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define synonyms and curate results — pin, boost, or hide specific hits for specific queries
